title: Friday - Ziyarat of Imam Mahdi (a.t.f.s.)
introduction:
ZIYARAH OF IMAM AL MAHDI (A.T.F.S.) ON FRIDAY

Friday is dedicated to Imam al-Mahdi, the Patron of the Age - peace be upon him - for his blessed advent will be on Friday. May Allah hasten his advent. So, when you visit him on Fridays, you are recommended to say the following:

Commenting on this Ziyarah, Sayyid Ibn Tawus says: As I say this form of Ziyarah, I cite this couple of poetic verses as the best expression of my feeling:

verses.arabic: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا حُجَّةَ اللّٰهِ فِيْ اَرْضِهِ
verses.translation: Peace be upon you, O argument of Allah in His lands!

verses.arabic: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا عَيْنَ اللّٰهِ فِي خَلْقِهِ
verses.translation: Peace be upon you, O sight of Allah on Plis creatures!
Peace be upon you, O light of Allah
by which those who have been guided [to the true guidance] are guided
and by which the believers are relieved!
Peace be upon you, O polite and fearful!
Peace be upon you, O sincere patron!
Peace be upon you, O ark of salvation!
Peace be upon you, O essence of life!
Peace be upon you.
May Allah send blessings to you
and upon your Household,
the pure and immaculate.
Peace be upon you.
May Allah hasten that which He has promised you;
namely, victory and prevalence of your authority.
Peace be upon you, O my master.
I am a servant of you
and I recognize the first and the last of your affair.

verses.arabic: اَتَقَرَّبُ اِلَى اللّٰهِ تَعَالٰى بِكَ وَ بِاٰلِ بَيْتِكَ
verses.translation: I seek nearness to Allah, the Exalted, through your Household and you

verses.arabic: وَ اَنْتَظِرُ ظُهُوْرَكَ وَ ظُهُوْرَ الْحَقِّ عَلٰى يَدَيْكَ،
verses.translation: and I am expecting your advent and the prevalence of the truth at your hands.

verses.arabic: وَ اَسْاَلُ اللهَ اَنْ يُصَلِّيَ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
verses.translation: And I beseech Allah to send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,

verses.arabic: وَ اَنْ يَجْعَلَنِيْ مِنَ الْمُنْتَظِرِيْنَ لَكَ
verses.translation: and to include me with those who are expecting you,

verses.arabic: وَ التَّابِعِيْنَ وَ النَّاصِرِيْنَ لَكَ عَلٰى اَعْدَاۤئِكَ
verses.translation: those who follow you and support you against your enemies,

verses.arabic: وَ الْمُسْتَشْهَدِيْنَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ فِيْ جُمْلَةِ اَوْلِيَاۤئِكَ
verses.translation: and those who will be martyred in front of you in the group of your loyalists.
O my master, O Patron of the Age!
May Allah’s blessings be upon you
and upon your Household.
Today is Friday,

verses.arabic: وَ هُوَ يَوْمُكَ الْمُتَوَقَّعُ فِيْهِ ظُهُوْرُكَ
verses.translation: which is your day on which your advent is expected

verses.arabic: وَ الْفَرَجُ فِيْهِ لِلْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ عَلٰى يَدَيْكَ
verses.translation: to bring about relief to the believers at your hands,
and killing of the disbelievers with your sword.

verses.arabic: وَ اَنَا يَا مَوْلَايَ فِيْهِ ضَيْفُكَ وَ جَارُكَ
verses.translation: On this day, O my master, I am your guest and in your vicinity

verses.arabic: وَ اَنْتَ يَا مَوْلَايَ كَرِيْمٌ مِنْ اَوْلَادِ الْكِرَامِ
verses.translation: and you, my master, are generous and the descendant of the generous people,
and you are commanded to receive your guests and neighbors hospitably;
so, receive me as your guest and neighbor.
May Allah’s blessings be upon you
and upon your Household, the immaculate.

verses.arabic: نَزِيْلُكَ حَيْثُ مَا اتَّجَهَتْ رِكَابِيْ وَ ضَيْفُكَ حَيْثُ كُنْتُ مِنَ الْبِلَادِ
verses.translation: I am your visitor wherever I turn my face And I am your guest wherever I am.
